name: Abiko Takemaru
source: The [url=/s8827]scenario writer[/url] for [url=/v1241]Kamaitachi no Yoru[/url]. For the characters in the game, he used the names and likeness (without permission) of 12 different people who had been together at the skiing lodge Spur over a year ago. He has invited them all to Mikazuki Island to celebrate the game's success, but no one actually knows who he is or how he knew about them.
